title: INT-01 · Open sources: method and responsibility

blocks.text: INT-01 · Open sources: method and responsibility
Lesson overview

The course's INT track covers the professional reading of open sources in Arabic: newspapers, news agencies, institutional sites, press releases and public statements. It is not a form of investigative techniques: it is a form of linguistic method. You learn to understand who says what and with what degree of certainty, to distinguish a fact from an unverified opinion and statement, to compare two versions of the same fact, to document and quote sources, to translate them faithfully and to signal doubts. Learn limits: only public information, no personal data about private citizens, no false identity. All the texts of the unity are invented and concern themes of general chronicle. Two weeks.

rows: B1-15 (titles), B1-18 (sources on the news), B1-21 (summary), ONO-03 (own names)
12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 148–149), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, a workbook for the source cards, access to news sites in Arabic (for exercise 11), session with the tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognising the main types of Arab open source and distinguishing primary and secondary sources;
2. understanding and rendering in English the verbs of attribution and degrees of certainty ( ⁧أَكَّدَ⁩ , ⁧ذَكَرَ⁩ , ⁧زَعَمَ⁩ , ⁧نَفَى⁩ , ⁧يُرَجَّحُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَتَسَنَّ⁩
3. distinguish fact, opinion and statement that has not been verified;
4. compare two accounts of the same fact and write a neutral summary;
5. fill out a sheet-source and a short press review in English, in compliance with the rules of this Unity. Two-week plan.

blocks.text: 1. Dialogue 1 · The press review
At the police station. Commissioner Rossi asked Luca and Karīm a weekly review of what Arabic media write about a great festival of Arabic culture (invented) to be held in Milan next month.

rows: ⁧لُوكَا: كَرِيمُ، طَلَبَ مِنَّا المُفَوَّضُ رُوسِّي رَصْدًا إِعْلَامِيًّا لِمَا تَكْتُبُهُ الصُّحُفُ العَرَبِيَّةُ عَنْ مِهْرَجَانِ الثَّقَافَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ. مِنْ أَيْنَ نَبْدَأُ؟⁩
Luca: Karīm, Commissioner Rossi asked us for a review of what Arab newspapers write about the Arab culture festival. Where do we start?
⁧نَسْتَعْمِلُ المَصَادِرَ المَفْتُوحَةَ فَقَطْ، أَيِ⁩ : ⁧مِنَ القَوَاعِدِ. أَوَّلًا⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧المَنْشُورَةَ لِلْجَمِيعِ: الصُّحُفَ، وَالمَوَاقِعَ الرَّسْمِيَّةَ، وَالبَيَانَاتِ العَامَّةَ.⁩
Karīm: By the rules. First, we only use open sources, i.e. published for all: newspapers, official websites, public communications.
⁧كَرِيم: الحِسَابَاتُ العَامَّةُ لِلْمُؤَسَّسَاتِ وَالصُّحُفِ، نَعَمْ. أَمَّا الأَشْخَاصُ العَادِيُّونَ فَلَا: لَهُمْ حَقٌّ فِي الخُصُوصِيَّةِ، وَلَيْسُوا مَوْضُوعَ عَمَلِنَا.⁩

⁧نُوَثِّقُ كُلَّ⁩ : ⁧بِالضَّبْطِ. كُلُّ فِعْلٍ يَحْمِلُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الثِّقَةِ. وَثَالِثًا⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧شَيْءٍ: اسْمَ المَصْدَرِ، وَالتَّارِيخَ، وَالرَّابِطَ، وَالنَّصَّ الأَصْلِيَّ.⁩
Karīm: Exactly. Each verb brings a degree of trust. And third: we document everything: the name of the source, the date, the link, the original text.

2. What are open sources

rows: the website of a ministry, university, international organisation
primary for the decisions of the institution
secondary (reports), often the first to give the news
secondary; interviews are primary for the interviewee's words

blocks.text: public accounts of official pages on primary social networks if the account is verified and official institutions and media

Primary and secondary. The primary source is that which produces the information (the Ministry that publishes its decision); the secondary report (the newspaper that writes  the ministry has decided......) When possible, go back to the primary source: The newspaper may have summarized, translated or interpreted.
3. The rules of this course

rows: read newspapers, agencies, institutional sites, public communications
enter closed groups, private accounts, reserved areas
reporting public statements by institutions and public persons in their public role
collect personal information about private citizens
quote each source with title, date and link
create fake profiles or pretend to be another person
translate faithfully, even what we don't like
"Improving" a quotation or removing it from its context
presenting a hypothesis as a fact
quote short steps with the link to the original

blocks.text: The precise rules depend on the country and the type of assignment (in Italy, among other things, the legislation on the protection of personal data and copyright): those who work with open sources in a professional context follow the rules of their own institution. This course deals only with the linguistic method and uses invented or public texts on general news, culture, economy, sport and weather.

The adjectives. A remarkable success is a scandalous decision: an adjective of judgment transforms a fact into an opinion. In a review, he quotes and attributes the adjective: according to newspaper X, it is an extraordinary success. The title and the text. The title (B1-15) is often stronger than the text: ⁧إِضْرَابٌ يَشُلُّ المَدِينَةَ⁩ The strike paralyzes the city's position in the text can correspond to half of the lines still. You always read the article, not just the title.

Video call with Laylā.

7. Verify
1. Two independent sources. Two newspapers that quote the same agency are not two sources: they are a source repeated.
2. Go back to the primary source. Original statement on the Ministry's website, full report, video The whole press conference.
3. Check date and place. An old news relaunched today; a picture of another city.
4. Check names and numbers. The proper names and place names (ONO-03) are written in many ways; the figures can be rounded or confused (B1-13, B1-18).
5. Compare versions. If two sources give different numbers, report them both with their attribution.

Why so much care? Because the reader of the review must be able to control every statement. A review without sources, dates and links is not verifiable, and therefore cannot be used.
9. Translate for a review
1. Loyalty. Translate what the text says, with its degree of certainty; do not add explanations to the text (note them.)
3. Names and dates. Names in the current Italian form, if it exists, otherwise in a simple transcription and consistent; the date of the Egypt, if there is, converted and indicated (ONO-03).
4. Report doubts. An uncertain word is indicated by [?] and a note: ⁧يُعْلِن⁩ or ⁧يُعْلَن⁩ ».

10. Pronunciation

Read a quote. When you read a quote in an oral presentation aloud, it signals beginning and end with the words: ⁧يَقُولُ البَيَانُ⁩ : … ⁧اِنْتَهَى الاِقْتِبَاسُ⁩ The term "end of the quotation" is replaced by the following: He speaks the verb of attribution with clarity: it is the most important information for those who listen.

blocks.text: Notes of use. ⁧زَعَمَ⁩ and ⁧اِدَّعَى⁩ introduce a statement from which the journalist distanced himself; in an official statement, they are used to challenge the version of the other party: ⁧زَعَمَتِ الشَّرِكَةُ⁩ ... the company supports... ⁧مُفَبْرَك⁩ comes from English/French \\'fabricated, fabricqué \' and entered the Arabic journalistic as a quadrilitero verb ( ⁧فَبْرَكَ⁩ ). ⁧مَوْثُوق⁩ and ⁧مِصْدَاقِيَّة⁩ are the words of the evaluation: ⁧مَصْدَرٌ مَوْثُوقٌ⁩ • reliable source (s); ⁧مَوْقِعٌ يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى المِصْدَاقِيَّةِ⁩ It is a site without credibility.
